title: Mega Man X3
subtitle: SNES · Original game, not Zero Project
intro: A weakness route with every heart, tank, armor part and Ride Armor. Includes the Gold Armor decision and the timed route to Zero’s saber.

stages.name: Blizzard Buffalo
stages.tip: Charge the Buster. Climb the wall as he charges, air-dash over him and fire from behind. Avoid touching the wall when he crashes into it.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Near the start, find the ice blocks immediately after the Ride Armor pad. Drill through them to reach the heart.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Blizzard Buffalo · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: Leg Parts
items.text: At the far end of the snowy outdoor section, climb the raised right-hand platform. Dash-jump from its edge to the high ledge on the right and enter the capsule.
items.extra: Adds horizontal and upward air dashes.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Blizzard Buffalo · Leg Parts — full scene

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: After getting the legs, backtrack outside to the high ledge on the left where the stage first opened to the sky. Upward air-dash from the wall to reach the tank.
items.extra: Same visit: take the leg capsule before coming back for this.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Blizzard Buffalo · Sub Tank — full scene

stages.name: Toxic Seahorse
stages.tip: Place a Frost Shield where he lands. Jump over acid and reposition when he dissolves; another shield interrupts his next attack.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Climb the first tall waterfall shaft. At the top, continue climbing above the normal exit to the small upper ledge.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Toxic Seahorse · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: Kangaroo Ride Armor
items.need: Arm Parts + Frost Shield + Leg Parts
items.text: In the large underwater room, charge Frost Shield to make a floating ice platform. Ride it to the surface, cross left along the water and platforms, then upward air-dash to the high module ledge.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Toxic Seahorse · Kangaroo Ride Armor — full scene

items.name: Leg Chip
items.need: Leg Parts + Chimera and Frog Ride Armors
items.text: Use Frog in the flooded area to break the fans on the far right. Leave the armor and climb the shaft beyond the fans to the pink capsule.
items.when: SKIP on the Gold Armor route
items.extra: Optional alternative only. Taking any pink chip blocks Gold Armor; the Gold route skips all four. Gives two air dashes per jump.

stages.name: Tunnel Rhino
stages.tip: Fire Acid Burst into his charge. Air-dash over him before a wall impact; wait out the glowing invulnerable dash before attacking again.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Early in the tunnels, take the right branch to the giant hanging rock over spikes. Release charged Triad Thunder on solid ground to drop the rock, then cross it to the heart.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: Before the long drop in the first half of the stage, jump to the raised platform on the right. The tank is in plain sight.

items.name: Head Parts
items.text: Past the police encounter room, climb through the falling-boulder section. At the second hanging boulder, release charged Triad Thunder; climb the route it opens on the left.
items.extra: Shows remaining stage items on the map.

stages.name: Volt Catfish
stages.tip: Shoot Tornado Fang as he lands. In the second phase, hit him before he establishes his electric barrier to interrupt the charge.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Ride the second main elevator above the usual left exit. Dash across to the upper-right wall, slide to the heart over spikes, then wall-jump back immediately.

media.credit: Screenshot: Rhody Tobin / HonestGamers; game imagery © Capcom
media.alt: Volt Catfish · Heart Tank — full scene

items.name: Body Parts
items.text: Ride the later elevator to its upper-left exit. Stand on the unusual stationary platform and release charged Gravity Well; it rises to the capsule.
items.extra: Reduces damage and adds a brief protective field after a hit.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: Beyond the police room, go up-left to the Ride Armor pad. Summon armor, drop down on the right to break the floor, then enter the lower passage.

stages.name: Crush Crawfish
stages.tip: Stay out of his claw grab. Use Triad Thunder close enough for its electric field to connect, then climb away before he rushes you.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: From the early Ride Armor pad, descend the broken platforms. Smash the cracked wall on the right with the armor to expose the heart.

items.name: Hawk Ride Armor
items.text: Find the small, differently marked floor near the beginning. Stand on it and release charged Triad Thunder to break through to the module.

items.need: Body Parts + Chimera Ride Armor unlocked
items.text: Take Ride Armor down the deep gap after the early platforms. Break the wall on the left at the bottom and leave the armor to enter the capsule.
items.when: SKIP on the Gold Armor route
items.extra: Optional alternative only. Taking any pink chip blocks Gold Armor; the Gold route skips all four. Improves damage protection.

stages.name: Neon Tiger
stages.tip: Hit him with Spinning Blade when he drops into reach. Move between the wall and center to dodge the spread shots; do not chase him into a jumping slash.

items.name: Sub Tank
items.text: In the first outdoor area, ride the dragonfly platform on the right. Jump to the high ledge at the right edge.

items.name: Arm Parts
items.text: After the early Sub Tank, cross left to the ladder and climb it. Go right to the cracked wall and break it with Tornado Fang. Dash-jump over the spikes, then upward air-dash to the capsule.
items.extra: Enables charged special weapons. Needed for the remaining armor and several modules.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Before the boss door, dash-jump or air-dash onto the wall above it. Climb to the heart ledge; use the nearby dragonfly platform for extra height if needed.

stages.name: Gravity Beetle
stages.tip: Use Ray Splasher while staying away from the bouncing gravity spheres. Give the huge black hole room; cross over him before you get trapped against a wall.

items.name: Heart Tank
items.text: Return to the first warehouse after defeating Blast Hornet. The crates blocking the upper-left ledge are gone; climb up for the heart.

items.name: Frog Ride Armor
items.text: At the first outdoor tower, climb the left side and upward air-dash to the small ledge holding the module.
items.extra: You can collect it now; Ride Armor pads activate only after finding Chimera.

items.need: Arm Parts + Chimera Ride Armor unlocked
items.text: Bring Ride Armor to the metal wall on the left before the final long vertical shaft. Break it with the armor and enter the pink capsule.
items.when: SKIP on the Gold Armor route
items.extra: Optional alternative only. Taking any pink chip blocks Gold Armor; the Gold route skips all four. Grants the Hyper Charge weapon.

stages.name: Blast Hornet
stages.tip: Use uncharged Gravity Well as he flies across the room. Avoid the tracking bees while waiting for the next opening.

items.name: Chimera Ride Armor
items.text: In the outdoor wooden-crate area, break the floor crates and drop below. Drill the cracked wall on the left, then destroy the machine holding the Ride Armor.
items.extra: Unlocks Ride Armor pads and the other collected modules.

items.text: Drive Chimera out of its underground room and continue right. At the low tunnel before the police room, jump in the armor, jump out while holding Up, then upward air-dash to the roof above the doorway.

items.when: SKIP on the Gold Armor route
items.extra: Optional alternative only. Taking any pink chip blocks Gold Armor; the Gold route skips all four. Regenerates health and fills tanks while you stand still.

routes.name: Standard · keep Zero as backup
routes.subtitle: All regular upgrades
routes.description: Follow the eight-boss chain and clear the return trips. The saber is optional.

steps.title: Buffalo → Seahorse → Rhino → Catfish
steps.text: Collect available hearts, tanks and the leg capsule.

steps.title: Crawfish → Tiger → Beetle → Hornet
steps.text: Take Tiger’s arms and Hornet’s Chimera module.

steps.title: Finish six return stages
steps.text: Collect all 20 regular pickups; decide whether to take one pink chip or hold out for Gold.

steps.title: Doppler fortress
steps.text: Keep X active for Mosquitus if you want Zero available for the normal ending.

routes.name: Completionist · Gold Armor + saber
routes.subtitle: Two decisions before the fortress
routes.description: Get every regular pickup, all chip abilities via Gold, and the saber. Zero retires after the transfer.

steps.title: Skip every pink capsule; keep Zero alive
steps.text: Use X for ordinary stages. A defeated Zero cannot return later for the saber.

steps.title: After Tiger, destroy Vile permanently
steps.text: Finish his unarmored phase with Ray Splasher or Spinning Blade, then escape. Do this before the last two Mavericks.

steps.title: Beetle → Hornet → all return trips
steps.text: Complete hearts, tanks, base armor and Ride Armor modules.

steps.title: Doppler 1 Gold → Doppler 2 saber
steps.text: Arrive at Gold with full health; switch to Zero before entering Mosquitus’s room.

extraSections:
Zero’s saber & Vile detour

Do this before defeating all eight Mavericks. Vile’s optional teleporters disappear after that point. Keep Zero alive until Doppler Stage 2.

  1. After Neon Tiger, revisit Volt Catfish. Take the first elevator down below the normal route into Vile’s teleporter. Catfish is already defeated, so the factory’s escape elevators will work.
  2. Defeat Vile’s Ride Armor, then fight Vile himself. The final hit on his unarmored form must be Ray Splasher or Spinning Blade: he must explode rather than retreat.
  3. Escape the exploding factory before the 50-second timer runs out. Finish the remaining Mavericks and pickup cleanup.
  4. In Doppler Stage 2, pass the water/Ride Armor section as X. Before the next miniboss door, switch to Zero. Defeat Mosquitus as Zero; the scripted injury transfers the saber to X. Do not defeat this miniboss as X.
  5. After the transfer, Zero is unavailable for the rest of the run and the ending differs. Charge through X’s firing sequence to use the saber. This is a deliberate story branch, not a rescue.
⤢

Bit and Byte are separate decisions: destroying both changes the first fortress boss, but is not required to get the saber. Bit: finish with Frost Shield or Triad Thunder. Byte: finish with Tornado Fang or Ray Splasher. Other finishing weapons make them retreat.

Gold Armor & chip choices

Never install an individual pink chip on this route. A prior chip prevents the Gold capsule from appearing. The four pink-chip cards show alternatives for a different run.

  1. Collect eight hearts, four Sub Tanks, four base armor parts and all four Ride Armor modules. Leave the four pink capsules unused.
  2. In Doppler Stage 1, defeat the early REX-2000 miniboss and refill X’s health completely. In the spiked-ball section, slide down the left wall of the first pit into the hidden passage.
  3. Enter the capsule for all four enhancement effects together. Ordinary passwords do not retain Gold Armor; collect it again after loading a password.
⤢

Doppler fortress

Refill Sub Tanks before entering. Choose the saber branch above before reaching the second stage.

  1. Doppler 1: Gold Armor is here. If both Bit and Byte were destroyed, fight Press Disposer; otherwise they combine as Godkarmachine O Inary. Attack exposed weak points and keep away from the crushing machinery.
  2. Doppler 2: a permanently destroyed Vile unlocks the Mosquitus saber opportunity and leads to Volt Kurageil. If Vile survived, you face him again instead; this late fight cannot unlock the earlier saber route.
  3. Doppler 3: defeat the eight Maverick rematches with their listed weaknesses. Against Dr. Doppler, use Acid Burst only while his healing barrier is down.
  4. Final stage: use Spinning Blade on Sigma’s first form. Against Kaiser Sigma, hit the small exposed head with charged Buster shots, then climb quickly during the lava escape.

routeIntro: The four pink-chip locations are alternatives, not four items to collect. The completionist route replaces them with Gold Armor and adds Zero’s saber.
flowIntro: The numbered route uses weapons already available. A return arrow marks a pickup saved for cleanup.
basicsHtml:
Controls, tanks & returning to stages

Directions use actions rather than controller buttons: Jump, Dash, Fire and Special. Check your control mapping. Heart Tanks increase maximum health; Sub Tanks store excess health collected while your life bar is full. Exit from the pause menu works in cleared stages.

For an air dash, jump normally first; a dash-jump uses that movement allowance. Hold Up with Dash for the vertical air dash. Charge special weapons only after finding the Arm Parts. Keep Zero alive if you want his saber later.

warning.label: Permanent route decisions
warning.title: Want Gold Armor? Skip every pink chip. Want the saber? Keep Zero alive.
warning.text: Individual enhancement chips block Gold Armor. For the saber, permanently destroy Vile before all eight Mavericks are defeated, then use Zero for Mosquitus in Doppler Stage 2. This route pauses after boss 6 for Vile.

completionText: 8 hearts · 4 Sub Tanks · 4 base armor parts · 4 Ride Armors. Gold route: zero individual pink chips, then collect Gold Armor. Saber route: Vile destroyed and Zero alive before Doppler Stage 2.

checkpoints.title: STOP AFTER 06 · Want Zero’s saber?
checkpoints.text: Destroy Vile permanently now, before the final two Mavericks.
checkpoints.stageText: Return to Volt Catfish and take the Vile teleporter. Finish unarmored Vile with Ray Splasher or Spinning Blade.
